programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Wild Slovakia
programme.desc: Brown bears, wolves, lynx, eagles… where within the European Union are these carnivores still regular inhabitants? Where can you find mountainous regions that yet wait to be discovered by mass tourism?

programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: The Curonian Spit is a narrow peninsula of dunes and forests shaped by destruction and recovery through careful human intervention.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Southern States
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.desc: Le cadavre défiguré d'un jeune homme est retrouvé dans une décharge. Il s'avère qu'il porte aussi les traces d'une grave infection.

programme.title: Soko Kitzbuehel | FR
programme.desc: Lukas, Nina et Kroisi se battent sur deux fronts à la fois. Ils doivent d'une part retrouver l'assassin d'un jeune homme dont le corps a été découvert au bord d'une route, un dénommé Jesse qui s'avère rapidement avoir été un adepte du street golf, et d'autre part élucider un vol d'explosifs dans une carrière de pierre.

programme.title: Soko Kitzbuehel | FR
programme.desc: Lukas, Nina et Kroisi vont devoir enquêter sur la mort dans le petit village de Schneeleiten de Marie Zimmermann, une généticienne venue y lancer un projet de recherches.

programme.title: Soko Kitzbuehel | FR
programme.desc: Flo et Mimi sont des déchétariens, comprenez qu'ils se nourrissent exclusivement de ce qu'ils trouvent dans les bennes à ordures des supermarchés et les poubelles des restaurants, voire de leurs voisins.

programme.title: Soko Linz | FR
programme.desc: Quand Livia Staupitz est retrouvée morte sur les rives du Danube, les soupçons se portent d'abord sur Lorenzo, son petit-ami qui est barman au Flux, un club de nuit ouvert très récemment.

programme.title: Soko Linz | FR
programme.desc: L'équipe de l'unité spéciale de Linz est envoyée sur une scène de crime des plus étranges : la directrice d'un musée a été assassinée et mise en scène pour l'inauguration d'une nouvelle exposition.

programme.title: Soko Linz | FR
programme.desc: Un avocat est assassiné après avoir proféré des menaces à sa femme en pleine procédure de divorce.

programme.title: Soko Linz | FR
programme.desc: Jens, un graffeur, est mort en tombant dans le vide alors qu'il s'apprêtait à réaliser une fresque avec son crew, Kathrin et Mahid.

programme.title: Soko Linz | FR
programme.desc: Quand Johannes Raininger est retrouvé mort sur un parking avec plusieurs chiots enfermés dans une cage à l'arrière de son véhicule, l'équipe de Nele comprend assez rapidement que ce triste personnage précédemment condamné pour trafic de drogue s'est reconverti dans le trafic de chiot.

programme.sub-title: Il Re Del Bisturi | Stagione 6 ep.05
programme.desc: Naomi, giovane mamma di 26 anni, dopo due allattamenti vuole recuperare le forme floride di un tempo e sentirsi nuovamente bella e sicura della propria femminilità.

programme.title: Il Re Del Bisturi
programme.sub-title: Il Re Del Bisturi | Stagione 6 ep.06
programme.desc: Mirtò ha sempre vissuto il suo seno grande come un problema. Ora desidera ridurlo per sentirsi più libera, leggera e in armonia con la propria immagine.

programme.title: Storie Di Clinica
programme.desc: In questo episodio esploriamo diversi trattamenti di medicina estetica come la pulizia medicale del viso, il rinofiller per armonizzare il profilo nasale e la beautification ovvero il miglioramento estetico globale.

programme.title: Storie Di Clinica
programme.desc: In questo episodio parliamo di botox del muscolo massetere, del protocollo per il ringiovanimento del volto con macchinari e iniettivi. E del perché la lingua è fondamentale per l’igiene orale e la postura mandibolare.

programme.title: Storie Di Clinica
programme.desc: In questo episodio una paziente si sottopone a carbossiterapia e laser CO2 mentre un’altra è venuta per un filler ma presenta un naso che ostacola la respirazione nasale: parliamo dell’importanza della respirazione corretta.

programme.title: Hai detto Feng Shui?
programme.sub-title: Hai detto Feng Shui ! Stagione 2 Ep. 2
programme.desc: Come trovare benessere ed equilibrio quando il lavoro è sempre in movimento? Ne parlo con Giulia Casavecchia, direttore commerciale nel settore della distribuzione cinematografica, esplorando il valore delle relazioni nei contesti lavorativi dinamici.

programme.title: Restyling Souls
programme.desc: Dopo un intervento di chirurgia bariatrica, Rebecca ha cambiato il suo corpo, ma non il modo di vedersi. Con Restyling Souls scoprirà che la vera trasformazione nasce dall’accettazione di sé e dalla consapevolezza del proprio valore.

programme.title: Bellezza Su Misura
programme.desc: Marzia e Martina sono due giovani amiche che hanno vite molto diverse ma lo stesso desiderio: sottoporsi insieme ad un intervento di mastoplastica additiva per avere finalmente il décolleté che hanno sempre sognato.

programme.title: Bellezza Su Misura
programme.desc: Fabio è un brillante organizzatore di eventi che usa il suo viso come uno strumento del suo lavoro, fa spesso ricorso alla chirurgia e sente il bisogno di un nuovo lifting al volto per ‘fotografare’ un momento felice della sua vita.

programme.title: Sos Cambio Pelle 01
programme.desc: Manuela ha vissuto un periodo delicato che le ha procurato una forte perdita di capelli. Gianni ha una serie di arrossamenti sul volto che vuole curare. Giada dopo tanti trattamenti andati male vuole risolvere un problema di diradamento di capelli.

programme.title: Sos Cambio Pelle 01
programme.desc: Stefano ha risolto i suoi problemi di psoriasi a placche grazie alla cura prescritta dalla Dottoressa. Federica soffre di dermatite atopica e di orticaria cronica. Eleonora vuole dedicarsi un po’ a sé stessa e regalarsi un volto più fresco.

programme.title: Il Legionario - Fuga all'inferno
programme.desc: Film storico e d'azione che vanta tra i protagonisti il grande Mickey Rourke. Primo secolo avanti Cristo, durante l'invasione della Partia, due legioni romane sono bloccate fra le montagne innevate dell'Armenia e rischiano di morire lentamente di freddo. Sarà Noreno, soldato per metà romano, ad avere l'arduo compito di attraversare le montagne per chiedere aiuto.

programme.title: Jill Rips - Indagine a luci rosse
programme.desc: Un ex poliziotto torna a Boston dopo l'omicidio del fratello e inizia un'indagine personale. Seguendo una scia di delitti, si addentra in un mondo oscuro di corruzione, ossessioni e vendetta.

programme.title: Giustizia a ogni costo
programme.desc: Un veterano rientrato dall'Iraq interviene per difendere una donna da una banda criminale. La sua scelta scatena una violenta vendetta e lo costringe a tornare a combattere per proteggere la propria famiglia.

programme.title: Devil's Tomb - A caccia del diavolo
programme.desc: Un gruppo scelto di mercenari, sotto il comando del veterano di guerra Mack, si mette in contatto con Elissa, affascinante agente della Cia, decisa ad aiutare uno scienziato che lavora su una scoperta archeologica nascosta sotto la superficie del deserto del Medio Oriente.

programme.title: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Action thriller adrenalinico con Cuba Gooding Jr. e Christian Slater. Un poliziotto che opera sotto copertura si trova inaspettatamente coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droga. Durante un'indagine un giovane spacciatore affida al poliziotto una bambina di cinque anni. Sarà l'inizio di numerosi colpi di scena che porteranno a delle conseguenze inaspettate.

programme.title: Absolute Deception
programme.desc: Miles, informatore chiave dell'agente dell'FBI John Nelson (il premio Oscar, Cuba Gooding Jr.), viene sequestrato e assassinato. Alla ricerca di informazioni utili, Nelson si reca a New York dalla vedova di Miles, la giornalista Rebecca, che nonostante le perplessità accetta di aiutarlo a scoprire cosa nascondesse il marito. I fatti che emergeranno dalle indagini, li lasceranno senza parole.

programme.title: General Commander
programme.desc: Thriller drammatico con il grande Steven Seagal. Un agente segreto ha visto morire uno dei suoi uomini durante un'operazione. Deciso a vendicarsi contro Orsini, il capo mafioso responsabile della morte del collega, non ha il sostegno della CIA ed è costretto a formare una squadra tutta sua.

programme.title: Rogue – Missione ad alto rischio
programme.desc: Samantha O'Hara è una mercenaria a capo di una squadra di soldati chiamati a una missione tanto audace quanto pericolosa: salvare alcuni ostaggi dai loro rapitori in una remota zona dell'Africa. Il gruppo sarà però costretto a fronteggiare violenti banditi, e dovrà anche vedersela con un branco di leoni pronti a tutto pur di proteggere il loro territorio.

programme.title: Killbird - Caccia alla spia
programme.desc: Thriller ad alta tensione dove nulla è come sembra… Una giovane fotografa resta bloccata in una zona isolata e chiede aiuto a un uomo solitario e inquietante. Quello che sembra un semplice equivoco si trasforma presto in un incubo, quando lui la accusa di essere una spia. Ma chi sta davvero mentendo?

programme.title: Shut in - In trappola
programme.desc: Intrappolata nel ripostiglio della vecchia casa di famiglia, una giovane madre di due figli, si ritrova ostaggio del suo passato: un ex tossicodipendente e un predatore senza scrupoli pronti a minacciare la sua famiglia. Ma quando i suoi figli diventano il bersaglio, la casa si trasforma in una trappola mortale e la donna dovrà lottare fino all'ultimo respiro per proteggerli e salvarsi.

programme.title: Bandit
programme.desc: Fuggito da una prigione americana, Gilbert Galvan assume una nuova identità in Canada e diventa uno dei rapinatori di banche più prolifici del paese, conducendo una doppia vita mentre la polizia stringe il cerchio.

programme.title: Legacy - La prova
programme.desc: Un criminale di guerra, narcotrafficante, viene arrestato a Belgrado da Nolan dell'MI6 e dalla polizia. Viene trasferito all'Aia per essere processato, ma il feroce criminale assume un assassino per far fuori dei testimoni: un adolescente e suo padre adottivo.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Due ladri accettano un colpo che prevede il rapimento di un neonato. Quando iniziano ad affezionarsi al bambino, decidono di proteggerlo e si ritrovano contro i criminali che li avevano assoldati.

programme.title: La vendetta del dragone
programme.desc: Steelhead, clandestino in Giappone, si ritrova ben presto al comando di una mafia che governa il mercato nero. A capo del pericoloso e redditizio distretto di Shinjuku, l'ascesa di Steelhead al potere mafioso va rapidamente fuori controllo quando uccide un potente boss della Yakuza.

programme.title: La vendetta del dragone
programme.desc: Steelhead, clandestino in Giappone, si ritrova ben presto al comando di una mafia che governa il mercato nero. A capo del pericoloso e redditizio distretto di Shinjuku, l'ascesa di Steelhead al potere mafioso va rapidamente fuori controllo quando uccide un potente boss della Yakuza.

programme.title: Twin Dragons
programme.desc: Due gemelli separati alla nascita crescono in mondi completamente diversi: uno diventa musicista, l'altro meccanico e combattente di strada. Quando si incontrano per caso, vengono continuamente scambiati l'uno per l'altro.

programme.title: Massacro a San Francisco
programme.desc: Un poliziotto americano di origini cinesi, esperto nelle arti marziali, combatte la più potente banda criminale di San Francisco, responsabile della morte del suo partner.

programme.title: Foxtrap
programme.desc: Su incarico della famiglia, un detective affronta una missione oltreoceano per riportare a casa una ragazza americana fuggita in Europa. Diretto e interpretato da Fred Williamson

programme.title: Kill Mode
programme.desc: Dopo una devastante epidemia, un regime autoritario controlla ciò che resta della società. Un gruppo di ribelli scopre una donna che potrebbe contenere la chiave per una cura e decide di proteggerla a ogni costo.

programme.title: Shopping
programme.desc: Dopo essere uscito di prigione, Billy si dedica al violento rituale del "ram-raiding". Il giovane, a bordo di auto rubate, si scaglia contro le vetrine dei negozi rubando tutto ciò che trova prima che arrivi la polizia. La sua compagna Jo sogna, però, un futuro insieme a Billy lontano dai pericoli e dalla città, ma il giovane, prima di abbandonare il campo, vuole misurarsi con il rivale Tommy.

programme.title: Drone
programme.desc: Thriller ad alta tensione diretto da Jason Bourque, che esplora i pericoli dell'era tecnologica e i dilemmi morali legati all'uso dei droni nei conflitti moderni. Con un cast d’eccezione composto da Sean Bean, Patrick Sabongui e Mary McCormack, Drone è un’avvincente storia di segreti, vendetta e responsabilità.

programme.title: Brace for impact – Indagine ad alta quota
programme.desc: Dopo la morte del fratello in un incidente aereo, un'esperta di disastri in volo decide di indagare. Gli indizi la conducono verso un possibile complotto terroristico che nessuno sembra disposto a prendere sul serio.

programme.title: Rischio d’impatto
programme.desc: Un ex controllore del traffico aereo, segnato da un tragico incidente, viene richiamato in servizio durante una crisi che mette in pericolo numerosi voli.

programme.title: The Wave
programme.desc: Un geologo individua segnali inquietanti nella montagna che domina il fiordo di Geiranger. Quando una frana gigantesca scatena uno tsunami devastante, ha pochi minuti per salvare la famiglia e fuggire da una massa d'acqua capace di cancellare l'intera valle.

programme.title: Day zero
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo gli Stati Uniti ripristinano la leva militare. Tre amici ricevono l'ordine di presentarsi entro trenta giorni e devono decidere come affrontare una scelta che cambierà per sempre le loro vite.

programme.title: Dragon Blade - La battaglia degli imperi
programme.desc: Sulla Via della Seta, il comandante Huo An incontra una legione romana guidata da Lucius. I due uomini uniscono le forze per affrontare un nemico comune e impedire che la regione precipiti nella guerra.

programme.title: In the Name of the King
programme.desc: Farmer, un uomo semplice e pacifico, vede il proprio villaggio devastato dai feroci Krug: suo figlio viene ucciso e sua moglie rapita. Costretto a impugnare le armi, intraprende una missione disperata per salvarla, vendicarsi e fermare il malvagio stregone Gallian prima che conquisti il regno.

programme.title: In the Name of the King 2: Two Worlds
programme.desc: Granger, ex soldato delle Forze Speciali, viene misteriosamente trasportato in un regno medievale. Qui scopre di essere l'uomo indicato da un'antica profezia e dovrà affrontare nemici, magie e tradimenti per salvare il regno, trovando allo stesso tempo una possibilità di redenzione.

programme.title: Giustizia a ogni costo
programme.desc: Un veterano rientrato dall'Iraq interviene per difendere una donna da una banda criminale. La sua scelta scatena una violenta vendetta e lo costringe a tornare a combattere per proteggere la propria famiglia.

programme.desc: Un veterano rientrato dall'Iraq interviene per difendere una donna da una banda criminale. La sua scelta scatena una violenta vendetta e lo costringe a tornare a combattere per proteggere la propria famiglia.

programme.title: Jill Rips - Indagine a luci rosse
programme.desc: Un ex poliziotto torna a Boston dopo l'omicidio del fratello e inizia un'indagine personale. Seguendo una scia di delitti, si addentra in un mondo oscuro di corruzione, ossessioni e vendetta.

programme.title: I soldati dell'imperatore
programme.desc: Negli anni di governo della dinastia Qing, l'imperatore Yong Zheng istituisce una squadra segreta di assassini, noti come le Ghigliottine, per eliminare tutti coloro che si oppongono al suo potere. L'ascesa al trono del nuovo imperatore Qian Long, aperto a idee più occidentali e alla tecnologia, porterà la squadra a instaurare un regno di terrore e oppressione nella regione degli Han.

programme.title: L'impero e la gloria
programme.desc: Nel 1597, durante la seconda invasione giapponese della Corea, la flotta nipponica si prepara a sferrare un nuovo attacco per annientare le ultime navi da guerra di Joseon e invadere il regno. L’ammiraglio Yi Sun-shin, in passato imprigionato e torturato con l’accusa di tradimento, raduna le 12 navi superstiti. Rifiutando la resa, mette in atto un piano audace per affrontare il nemico.

programme.title: Noryang: La battaglia finale
programme.desc: Ultimo capitolo della saga sulle invasioni giapponesi della Corea. È l'inverno del 1598 quando la guerra di Imjin, durata sette anni, si avvicina al termine. L'ammiraglio Yi Sun-shin guida una flotta alleata di navi Joseon e Ming per annientare l'esercito Wae. Le forze navali si scontrano nello stretto di Noryang, il mare mortale dove l'ammiraglio Yi combatte la sua ultima valorosa battaglia.

programme.title: La spada e la rosa
programme.desc: Un'antica profezia racconta che un giovane uomo sarà capace di sovvertire l'ordine del regno fantastico di Huadu, dove una temibile imperatrice ha assoggettato gli uomini rendendoli schiavi e reso le donne spietate combattenti. Quando Char giungerà a Huadu, la sovrana capirà che la profezia sta per divenire realtà e farà di tutto per fermare il giovane.

programme.title: La gang degli svitati
programme.desc: Un'esplosiva miscela di arti marziali e comicità con Jackie Chan e Sammo Hung. Due agenti di Hong Kong sono a Tokyo per catturare un ex poliziotto fuggito con dei diamanti. Quando uno di loro viene rapito da una gang, l'altro chiede aiuto alla sua vecchia e sgangherata banda di amici d'infanzia, i "Five Lucky Stars".

programme.title: Police Story 3: Supercop
programme.desc: L'ispettore Ka-Kui viene incaricato di infiltrarsi nel cartello di un narcotrafficante. Fingendosi detenuto, si avvicina al braccio destro del boss per smantellare l'organizzazione dall'interno.

programme.title: Il trafficante - 60 minuti per l'inferno
programme.desc: Un pilota ha un'ora per attraversare il confine con un carico di droga e chiudere il suo ultimo lavoro. Intrappolato tra cartello, DEA e un sicario, deve mantenere tutti convinti che il piano stia funzionando mentre tenta disperatamente di salvare anche sua moglie.

programme.title: Escape from Pretoria
programme.desc: La vera storia dell'incredibile evasione di Tim Jenkin e Stephen Lee, due giovani bianchi sudafricani detenuti come terroristi nella prigione di Pretoria durante il regime dell'Apartheid nel 1978. Imprigionati per le loro azioni radicali, i due giovani attivisti escogiteranno un piano per evadere, tanto originale quanto pericoloso.

programme.title: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Antonio Banderas è Ned Cruz, un detective privato ingaggiato da un russo per rintracciare la sua fidanzata scomparsa con 30 milioni di dollari in diamanti, ma la missione si complica quando tutti coloro che interroga finiscono morti.

programme.title: Immagini - Imagining Argentina
programme.desc: Con Antonio Banderas ed Emma Thompson, la vicenda esplora il dramma dei desaparecidos nell'Argentina della spietata dittatura militare. Quando l'amata moglie giornalista viene improvvisamente rapita dal regime, un regista teatrale scopre di possedere un misterioso dono chiaroveggente. Sfidando il terrore, utilizzerà le sue oscure visioni per tentare disperatamente di salvarle la vita.

programme.title: Security
programme.desc: Eddie Deacon (Antonio Banderas), ex ufficiale e reduce della guerra in Afghanistan, dopo un po' di tempo dal suo rientro in patria, trova impiego come vigilante notturno in un centro commerciale. Durante la sua prima notte di lavoro si imbatte in una bambina, testimone chiave di un processo, che sta scappando da un gruppo di mercenari intenzionati ad eliminarla ad ogni costo. Con Ben Kingsley.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.desc: Yksi maailman menestyneimmistä brittiläisistä reality-ohjelmista. Innokkaat yrittäjät markkinoivat liikeideoitaan monimiljonäärisijoittajille toivoen saavansa sijoitusrahaa.

programme.title: Still born : au-dela de deux ames
programme.desc: une nouvelle mère, donne naissance à des jumeaux, mais un seul d'entre eux est survie. Tout en s'occupant de son seul enfant Adam, elle soupçonne que quelque chose, une entité surnaturelle, l'a choisi et ne reculera devant rien pour le lui enlever.

programme.title: Two Eyes Staring
programme.desc: Paul, Christine et leur petite fille de 9 ans, Lisa, forment une famille ordinaire. Ils héritent d’une effrayante demeure laissée par la mère de Christine avec laquelle ils n’avaient plus de relations. Peu de temps après avoir emménagé, Lisa a d’étranges visions et se rend compte que sa sinistre nouvelle amie n’est autre que le fantôme de la jumelle morte de sa maman. Le père de Lisa finit lui aussi par suspecter sa femme de cacher un horrible secret, ce qui aura des conséquences mortelles….

programme.title: L'antre
programme.desc: Un garçon et une fille vont dans la forêt pour creuser un trou jusqu'en enfer. Réputé comme film maudit des années 1970 Antrum examine le pouvoir terrifiant de la narration.

programme.title: It Came from the Desert
programme.desc: Les fourmis sont les véritables vedettes de ce buddy-movie qui rend un hommage direct aux films de monstres des années 50. Inspiré du cultissime jeu vidéo des années 80 It came from the desert ce film déjanté est un fabuleux mélange de fourmis géantes et de courses de moto dans le désert… Nouveau Mexique - Se rendant à une Keg Party où la bière coule à flots nos 2 coureurs de motocross vont faire une rencontre inattendue en tombant par hasard sur un ancien site militaire. Des expérimentations secrètes visant à croiser leur l’ADN avec des débris d’une métérorite trouvée en 1951 ont été menées sur des fourmis et araignées….et qui ont donné naissance à des fourmis géantes mutantes !

programme.title: Compulsion
programme.desc: Amy, est une chef cuisinière qui rêve d'avoir son propre show télévisé culinaire. Elle est jalouse de sa voisine de palier, Saffron, qui est quant à elle une ancienne enfant star. Les deux femmes, souffrent de troubles obsessionnels à des degrés différents, elles vont confronter leurs univers intimes dans une bataille de volontés face à leurs troubles alimentaires et sexuels.

programme.title: RED SNOW
programme.desc: Une romancière vampire en difficulté doit se défendre contre de vrais vampires pendant Noël à Lake Tahoe.

programme.title: Claw
programme.desc: Deux amis contraints de passer la nuit dans une ville fantôme se retrouvent chassés par un prédateur préhistorique.

programme.title: Nazis au centre de la terre
programme.desc: Des chercheurs en Antarctique sont enlevés et traînés sous terre par une équipe de survivants nazis qui planifient la renaissance du Troisième Reich.

programme.title: Xtro 3
programme.desc: Des marines se rendent sur une île déserte pour désamorcer des bombes, mais ils sont terrorisés par une créature extraterrestre mortelle.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: Terreur sur la lagune
programme.desc: Le corps d'une écolière est retrouvé dans une prairie. Le meurtrier n'est jamais arrêté et, des années plus tard, un jeune homme nommé Stefano retourne sur l'île et retrouve son frère, le prêtre local.

programme.title: Pulse 3
programme.desc: Sept ans après l’invasion, l’humanité a fui les villes où des milliards de personnes sont mortes à cause d’une peste propagée par Internet. JUSTINE (17 ans) rêve d’une vie au-delà de son camp de réfugiés misérable, où toute technologie est interdite. Elle découvre le dernier ordinateur portable fonctionnel et l’ouvre, tel la boîte de Pandore. Quelqu’un l’attend en ligne. Et cette personne veut désespérément la rencontrer. Mais il y a une condition : elle doit retourner en ville. Animée d’un désir plus fort que la peur, Justine entreprend un voyage terrifiant vers le cœur de l’endroit où tout a commencé. Ce qui l’attend là-bas dépasse tout ce qu’elle aurait pu imaginer.

programme.title: Mémoires diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: La Nettoyeuse
programme.desc: Pour se distraire d'une liaison une femme amoureuse se lie d'amitié avec une femme de ménage gravement brûlée. Elle apprend vite que ces cicatrices sont bien plus profondes que la surface.

programme.title: La Nettoyeuse
programme.desc: Pour se distraire d'une liaison une femme amoureuse se lie d'amitié avec une femme de ménage gravement brûlée. Elle apprend vite que ces cicatrices sont bien plus profondes que la surface.

programme.title: Big Foot
programme.desc: En 1970, deux hommes aux destins opposés : Harley Anderson et Simon Quint doivent s'unir pour chasser une créature légendaire vivant dans les montagnes : le `Big foot'.

programme.title: Lifechanger
programme.desc: Un métamorphe meurtrier se livre à une mission sanglante pour arranger les choses avec la femme qu'il aime.

programme.title: Terror Hospital
programme.desc: Un groupe d'étudiants décide de se faire peur le soir d'Halloween en allant visiter un hôpital psychiatrique désaffecté. Hélàs, l'esprit d'un patient, autrefois brûlé vif alors qu'il tentait de s'enfuir, hante les lieux. Le fantôme psychopathe veut par tous les moyens quitter les lieux pour de bon...

programme.title: Les ombres du desert
programme.desc: Une famille qui traverse le Nevada en voiture décide de prendre des photos dans une ville fantôme isolée appelée Weaver, et des choses horribles commencent à se produire.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: La famille Haloran a hérité d'un château ancestral mais l'héritage inclut l'avarice, la tromperie et la mort.

programme.title: Le projet atticus
programme.desc: À l'automne 1976, un petit laboratoire de psychologie en Pennsylvanie est devenu, malgré lui, le lieu du seul cas de possession confirmé par le gouvernement. L'armée américaine a pris le contrôle du laboratoire sur ordre de la sécurité nationale et, peu après, a mis en place des mesures visant à militariser l'entité. Les détails des événements inexplicables qui s'y sont produits sont rendus publics après être restés classifiés pendant près de quarante ans.

programme.title: 12 Feet Deep
programme.desc: Deux sœurs (Alexandra Park et Nora-Jane Noone) sont piégées sous la protection en verre automatique d'une piscine olympique et doivent survivre dans l'eau en pleine nuit.

programme.title: Feast 2
programme.desc: Les monstres ont envahi une petite ville voisine perdue au milieu de nulle part, et les habitants doivent s'allier avec les survivants du massacre du bar pour trouver comment survivre.

programme.title: The Blazing World
programme.desc: Des décennies après la noyade accidentelle de sa soeur jumelle, une jeune femme autodestructrice retourne dans sa maison familiale, se retrouvant attirée par une autre dimension où sa soeur est peut-être encore en vie.

programme.title: La nuit des morts-vivants
programme.desc: Barbra et Johnny rendent visite à la tombe de leur père dans un cimetière isolé lorsqu'ils sont soudain attaqués par des zombies. Barbra parvient à s'échapper et se réfugie dans ce qui semble être une ferme abandonnée. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Ben, qui s'est arrêté à la maison car il avait besoin d'essence. Assiégés par les morts-vivants, Ben fait de son mieux pour sécuriser les portes et les fenêtres. Les informations à la télévision sont inquiétantes : des créatures reviennent à la vie partout. Barbra et Ben sont surpris de découvrir cinq personnes cachées au sous-sol : Harry, Helen et Karen Cooper, ainsi qu'un jeune couple, Tom et Judy. Les dissensions apparaissent presque immédiatement, Harry Cooper voulant prendre le commandement. À mesure que la situation se dégrade, leurs chances de survivre à la nuit diminuent minute après minute.

programme.title: La Nuit des chauves-souris 2
programme.desc: L'histoire suit un groupe de soldats en mission dans une zone isolée pour capturer un scientifique fou, qui se retrouve la proie de chauves-souris carnivores génétiquement modifiées.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln Contre Les Zombies
programme.desc: Durant la guerre civile, Abraham Lincoln apprend qu'une menace pèse sur l'avenir des États-Unis. Une armée de morts-vivants sudistes erre sur la surface du continent. En passant derrière les lignes ennemies, le Président se donne pour mission de détruire les zombies...

programme.title: Alien invasion
programme.desc: Une machine à tuer venue d'un autre monde arrive sur Terre pour tuer des humains.

programme.title: Alien invasion
programme.desc: Une machine à tuer venue d'un autre monde arrive sur Terre pour tuer des humains.

programme.title: Two Eyes Staring

Le père de Lisa finit lui aussi par suspecter sa femme de cacher un horrible secret, ce qui aura des conséquences mortelles….

programme.title: Spasmo
programme.desc: Christian tombe amoureux d'une mystérieuse jeune femme. Quand un homme fait irruption dans leur chambre d'hôtel et que Christian le tue accidentellement, les choses deviennent de plus en plus irrationnelles.

programme.title: Autopsy
programme.desc: Une bande d'adolescents s'en donne à coeur joie lors de la fête du Mardi Gras. Sur le chemin du retour, ils frappent de plein fouet un homme apparu de nulle part. Ayant à peine le temps de constater les dégâts, une ambulance arrive sur les lieux. L'ambulancier offre aux jeunes de les embarquer, question de s'assurer qu'ils ne sont pas blessés suite à l'impact. Le groupe est donc transporté dans un vieil hôpital miteux où il est accueilli par une infirmière totalement déconnectée de la réalité. À mesure que les adolescents sont appelés pour être examinés, il devient clair qu'ils étaient beaucoup plus en sécurité à l'extérieur du bâtiment.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: Un brillant scientifique expérimente un nouveau pesticide sur des guèpes. Celles qui survivent au produit voient leurs forces décuplées et leur agressivité étrangement exacerbée. Les habitants d'une petite ville des Etats-Unis se retrouvent alors confrontés à un essaim de guèpes mutantes extrêmement dangereuses.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: La famille Haloran a hérité d'un château ancestral mais l'héritage inclut l'avarice, la tromperie et la mort.

programme.title: Pulse 2: Afterlife
programme.desc: Après que des fantômes ont envahi le monde des humains par le biais d'Internet, un père doit protéger sa fille de l'esprit psychotique de son ex-femme.

programme.title: La Nuit de tous les mysteres
programme.desc: L'excentrique millionnaire Fredrick Loren et sa quatrième épouse, Annabelle, ont invité cinq personnes à passer la nuit dans leur maison de la Colline Hantée pour une soirée maison hantée . Quiconque y passera la nuit remportera dix mille dollars. Au fil de la nuit, les invités se retrouvent piégés dans la maison, confrontés à des fantômes, des meurtriers et autres créatures terrifiantes.

L'écrivain américain à succès et athée Joseph Crone participe à un groupe de soutien pour accepter la mort de sa femme bien-aimée Sarah et de leur fils Diogo. Joe se lie d'amitié avec Sadie lors d'une des réunions, et elle l'aide après un accident de voiture. Lorsque Samuel Crone (Michael Landes), le frère religieux et éloigné de Joe, lui annonce que leur père est en phase terminale, Joe se rend à Barcelone pour rester auprès de son père mourant. Joe a des visions de démons et du chiffre 11, et il découvre qu'un événement maléfique impliquant Samuel et lui-même se produira le 11 novembre 2011.

programme.title: Ghost bastards
programme.desc: En octobre 2012, une vidéo est retrouvée au domicile de Malcolm Johnson et les enregistrements restent inexpliqués. Après ce prologue, l’histoire se déroule sous forme de flashback. Durant l’été 2012, Malcolm et Kisha emménagent ensemble et commencent une vie heureuse. Une nuit, Kisha remarque quelques phénomènes inexpliqués qui la convainquent que leur maison est hantée par des fantômes. Pour la rassurer, Malcolm engage une équipe de tournage pour filmer l’intérieur de la maison jour et nuit. Quelques nuits plus tard, Malcolm et Kisha ont des relations sexuelles devant la caméra, malgré les protestations de Kisha. En visionnant la vidéo le lendemain, ils remarquent plusieurs phénomènes paranormaux capturés sur la bande. Malcolm veut vendre la maison, mais le marché immobilier est lent. Il décide donc d’engager un médium pour enquêter. Après que Kisha avoue avoir conclu un pacte avec le diable pour une paire de chaussures, certaines choses commencent à s’expliquer, mais cela ne résout pas les problèmes causés par les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Mischief Night
programme.desc: A la suite d’un accident de voiture ayant couté la vie à sa mère la jeune Emily Watson a perdu la vue. La veille d’Halloween alors qu’elle se trouve seule chez elle un intrus s’introduit dans sa maison. Emily devra alors utiliser ses autres sens et surmonter son handicap pour échapper à cet inconnu.

programme.title: Mémoires diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Je suis une légende
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une épidémie ravage la Terre, la population périt ou se transforme en une sorte de zombie vivant dans l'obscurité. Le docteur Robert Morgan est le seul survivant en bonne santé de la planète. Sa vie, routinière pour assurer sa survie, se déroule ainsi : il élimine les créatures nocturnes le jour et veille à la sécurité de sa maison, pour être protégé la nuit. Il souffre de l'absence de sa femme et de sa fille bien-aimées, emportées par l'épidémie, et lutte contre sa solitude pour préserver sa santé mentale. Lorsqu'il découvre Ruth Collins, contaminée, il utilise son sang pour la guérir et devient le dernier espoir de la Terre pour les autres survivants infectés. Mais l'ordre de cette nouvelle société est terrifiant.

programme.title: Le dîner des vampires
programme.desc: Dans une paisible ferme à la campagne, les vampires de Grande-Bretagne se réunissent pour leur rencontre qui n’a lieu qu’une fois tous les cinquante ans. D’autres vont aussi les rejoindre : Sebastian Crockett, un jeune homme d’Essex naïf qui pense avoir rendez-vous avec la séduisante Vanessa, et un détachement de forces spéciales chasseurs de vampires qui vont se retrouver dépassés par la situation. Cette nuit promet d’être inoubliable… et pour certains, ce sera la dernière.

programme.title: San Andreas mega seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos descubren que el «Big One» se acerca, y con él todo al oeste de la falla de San Andrés se hundirá en el océano. Los científicos intentan detener el seísmo, pero mientras los temblores anticipados convierten California en un caos, es una carrera contrarreloj.

programme.title: Anillo del Engano
programme.desc: Desde que falleció su marido, Julie no había vuelto a salir con ningún otro hombre, hasta que conoce a Martin, un hombre apuesto. Pero tras esa apariencia se esconde un oscuro pasado.

programme.title: Secretas Intenciones
programme.desc: Una pareja contrata a una niñera para que cuide de sus hijos mientras ellos trabajan. Al principio, todo va perfectamente, pero cuando un incidente inseguro hace que los padres ya no quieran a la niñera cerca, descubren que esta niñera es experta en no ser desahuciada de su convivencia. Tanto, que puede convertir la vida de los padres en una auténtica pesadilla.

programme.title: Medianoche en San petersburgO
programme.desc: El exagente secreto británico Harry Palmer dirige ahora una agencia de investigación privada en Rusia. Recibe el encargo de localizar y recuperar un cargamento de plutonio robado y, con la ayuda de su colega Nikolai Petrov, parte hacia San Petersburgo para intentar encontrarlo. En el camino debe enfrentarse a la violenta mafia rusa y también buscar a Tatiana, la novia de Nikolai, que ha sido secuestrada.

programme.title: Un punado de polvo
programme.desc: El romance de la esposa y una muerte en la familia aceleran la desaparición de un matrimonio inglés de clase alta.

programme.title: Transpecos
programme.desc: Para tres agentes de la Patrulla Fronteriza que trabajan en un control remoto en el desierto, el contenido de un coche revelará un siniestro complot dentro de sus propias filas. Las próximas 24 horas los llevarán a un peligroso viaje que podría costarles la vida.

programme.title: Tercera identidad
programme.desc: El reportero de guerra británico Leo y la periodista estadounidense Sally se conocen en una misión en Beirut. Cuando Leo desaparece, Sally empieza a descubrir su vida secreta, que la lleva tras el Telón de Acero y a las garras del KGB. En HD.

programme.title: El niño de mamá
programme.desc: Tras un accidente que acaba con la vida de su hermano, un niño ve que su madre le culpa de la desgracia.

programme.title: El psicópata que conoció online
programme.desc: El marido de Karen tiene un accidente y queda desempleado. La falta de ingresos les hace alquilar dos habitaciones de su casa. Miranda es la primera en llegar, y les resulta agradable al conocerla.

programme.title: Acoso nupcial
programme.desc: Cuando Jenna conoce a la futura novia Marci y a su novio Glenn, se da cuenta de que Glenn es el hombre de sus sueños y no se detendrá ante nada para tenerlo solo para ella y hacer sus sueños realidad.

programme.title: La interpretacion de Rose
programme.desc: Durante un curso sobre eutanasia animal, la estudiante de veterinaria Rose (Ann Skelly) decide contactar a Ellen (Orla Brady), la madre biológica que la dio en adopción. Pero Ellen, ahora una exitosa actriz radicada en Londres, no quiere saber nada. Sin dejarse desanimar, Rose se niega a ser ignorada. Su curiosidad la lleva a descubrimientos que sacuden la frágil identidad que ha construido para sí misma. Los directores Christine Molloy y Joe Lawlor, conocidos como Desperate Optimists, llevan años creando un cine formalmente riguroso y atmosférico que a menudo explora los efectos inquietantes de la suplantación y la naturaleza escurridiza de la verdad. Con Rose Plays Julie (2019) han creado un thriller de combustión lenta que construye una sensación de inquietud dentro de un mundo exquisito de arquitectura impecable, representado a través de un estilo interpretativo frío y envuelto en una banda sonora claustrofóbica. Ann Skelly y Orla Brady ofrecen actuaciones precisas y contenidas, mientras la película nos lleva por el anhelo y la venganza hasta llegar a los lugares oscuros del poder y sus abusos. Es un cine franco, inmersivo y decididamente feminista.

programme.title: Inexorable
programme.desc: Las vidas de una acaudalada editora y su esposo novelista cambian con la llegada de una misteriosa joven a su mansión campestre.

programme.title: Juegos de mujer
programme.desc: Desde la década de los años 20, pasando por la Guerra Civil Española y el ascenso de Hitler al poder, las vidas de un maestro irlandés, una heredera provocadora y su musa española se entrecruzan.

programme.title: Juegos de mujer
programme.desc: Desde la década de los años 20, pasando por la Guerra Civil Española y el ascenso de Hitler al poder, las vidas de un maestro irlandés, una heredera provocadora y su musa española se entrecruzan.

programme.desc: En el Perú de 1714, un fraile es juzgado por la Inquisición por cuestionar las intenciones de Dios cuando cinco personas mueren en el derrumbe de un puente de cuerdas andino.

programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: Good Fences is about an upwardly-mobile Black family for whom the American dream becomes a nightmare. In the 1970s, Tom Spader is an attorney who is determined to end what he has dubbed the colored man's losing streak. When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.desc: Atrapado tras las líneas enemigas, un pequeño grupo de sobrevivientes disidentes lucha por permanecer oculto de los alemanes mientras utiliza una radio para transmitir un mensaje de esperanza.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: El joven Friederich proviene de orígenes humildes, pero llama la atención de su nuevo jefe, Karl. Al ofrecerse como tutor del hijo de su empleador, Friederich se siente cada vez más atraído por la joven esposa de Karl, Lotte. Sin embargo, ella se niega a traicionar a su marido, incluso cuando se enteran de que Friederich debe ir a México durante dos años para supervisar un proyecto minero para Karl. Friederich y Lotte se juran fidelidad, pero la inminente guerra los mantiene separados mucho más tiempo del esperado.

programme.title: The Employer
programme.desc: Cinco candidatos altamente cualificados se entrevistan para un codiciado puesto en la Corporación Carcharias, un poderoso conglomerado cuyas prácticas comerciales están envueltas en misterio. La noche anterior a la última ronda de entrevistas, son secuestrados y drogados. Al día siguiente, despiertan atrapados en una habitación cerrada sin ninguna esperanza de escapar. Pronto, la verdadera naturaleza de su situación se revela cuando reciben una llamada del misterioso director ejecutivo de Carcharias, conocido simplemente como El Empleador. Les informa que están a punto de vivir la entrevista final, pero no es en absoluto lo que esperaban.

programme.title: No olvidar
programme.desc: En un pueblo fronterizo de Tex-Mex, un hombre y su mujer deben enfrentarse a sus torturados pasados para salvar a su hija secuestrada.

programme.title: Una novia muy especial
programme.desc: Dos amigos de la infancia se reencuentran de adultos para ayudarse mutuamente a conquistar a las mujeres de sus sueños. Chris quiere casarse con Allison, una chica judía, para no tener que tomar nunca más una decisión en su vida. Adam está a punto de casarse con Hannah, una mujer con la que no es feliz. Cuando Chris pide la ayuda de Adam para fingir ser judío y así lograr que Allison salga con él, las culturas chocan y el caos se desata.

programme.title: La valija de Benavidez
programme.desc: Un pintor abandona su casa tras una pelea con su novia y, desesperado, acude a la casa de su psiquiatra en busca de ayuda. Después de pasar la noche allí y encontrar alivio, descubre la agenda secreta de su doctor, lo que lo cambia todo.

programme.title: Peppergrass
programme.desc: Durante una pandemia, una restauradora embarazada intenta robar una trufa de valor incalculable a un veterano solitario.

programme.title: Como satisfacer a una mujer
programme.desc: Cuando su negocio de limpieza de casas, compuesto solo por hombres, se sale de control, una mujer madura debe aceptar su propia sexualidad si quiere empezar una nueva vida.

programme.desc: Un oficinista desquiciado que planeaba disparar en su lugar de trabajo lucha con su nuevo estatus de héroe después de que termina deteniendo un tiroteo en su lugar.

programme.desc: Una hija acusa a su madre de matar a su novio, pero ¿fue realmente la madre quien lo hizo... o fue alguien que siempre ha estado ahí?

programme.desc: Atrapado tras las líneas enemigas, un pequeño grupo de sobrevivientes disidentes lucha por permanecer oculto de los alemanes mientras utiliza una radio para transmitir un mensaje de esperanza.

programme.title: The Employer
programme.desc: Cinco candidatos altamente cualificados se entrevistan para un codiciado puesto en la Corporación Carcharias, un poderoso conglomerado cuyas prácticas comerciales están envueltas en misterio. La noche anterior a la última ronda de entrevistas, son secuestrados y drogados. Al día siguiente, despiertan atrapados en una habitación cerrada sin ninguna esperanza de escapar. Pronto, la verdadera naturaleza de su situación se revela cuando reciben una llamada del misterioso director ejecutivo de Carcharias, conocido simplemente como El Empleador. Les informa que están a punto de vivir la entrevista final, pero no es en absoluto lo que esperaban.

programme.title: No olvidar
programme.desc: En un pueblo fronterizo de Tex-Mex, un hombre y su mujer deben enfrentarse a sus torturados pasados para salvar a su hija secuestrada.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: El joven Friederich proviene de orígenes humildes, pero llama la atención de su nuevo jefe, Karl. Al ofrecerse como tutor del hijo de su empleador, Friederich se siente cada vez más atraído por la joven esposa de Karl, Lotte. Sin embargo, ella se niega a traicionar a su marido, incluso cuando se enteran de que Friederich debe ir a México durante dos años para supervisar un proyecto minero para Karl. Friederich y Lotte se juran fidelidad, pero la inminente guerra los mantiene separados mucho más tiempo del esperado.

programme.title: Una novia muy especial
programme.desc: Dos amigos de la infancia se reencuentran de adultos para ayudarse mutuamente a conquistar a las mujeres de sus sueños. Chris quiere casarse con Allison, una chica judía, para no tener que tomar nunca más una decisión en su vida. Adam está a punto de casarse con Hannah, una mujer con la que no es feliz. Cuando Chris pide la ayuda de Adam para fingir ser judío y así lograr que Allison salga con él, las culturas chocan y el caos se desata.

programme.title: La valija de Benavidez
programme.desc: Un pintor abandona su casa tras una pelea con su novia y, desesperado, acude a la casa de su psiquiatra en busca de ayuda. Después de pasar la noche allí y encontrar alivio, descubre la agenda secreta de su doctor, lo que lo cambia todo.

programme.title: El vendaval de octubre
programme.desc: Una doctora invita en su casa a un hombre misterioso en su remota cabaña con una herida de bala.

programme.title: Daisy Winters
programme.desc: La hija de 11 años de una mujer que lleva años luchando contra el cáncer trama junto a su mejor amiga una forma de escapar de tener que vivir finalmente con su dura y conservadora tía tras la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Nacido del mal
programme.desc: Una joven se enamora de un hombre misterioso que revela su lado oscuro.

programme.title: Exploradores, en compañía de extraños
programme.desc: Tres compañías de paracaidistas viajan en una misión mortal a Francia para preparar la zona de lanzamiento del ataque aerotransportado del Día D. Tienen que instalar un transmisor Eureka y un reflector para guiar a los aviones en la invasión de Normandía.
